name: Verbio SE
summary: Verbio SE engages in the production and distribution of fuels and finished products in Germany, Europe, North America, and internationally. It operates through Biodiesel, Bioethanol/Biomethane, and Other segments. The company provides bio-based chemicals, biodiesel, pharma-glycerine, biomethane, and bioethanol; olefin metathesis catalysts; animal feeds, such as Verbio Proti Flow and Verbio Grain Pro; phytosterols under the Sterocellent brand name; and fertilizers. It also offers trading, and transport and logistics services.
